def solve2(G):
    H,W=len(G),len(G[0]); G=np.array(G)
    res=G.copy()
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            c=int(G[i][j])

                cnt=Counter(nb).most_common(2)
                res[i][j]=cnt[0][0] if len(cnt)>1 else c
    return [[int(x) for x in r] for r in res]

                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

        a=(max(ys)-min(ys)+1)*(max(xs)-min(xs)+1)

        boxes.append((fill,c,min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs),a))

    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(h):

def solve(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(g)
    boxes=[(c,min(y for y,_ in ps),max(y for y,_ in ps),min(x for _,x in ps),max(x for _,x in ps),len(ps)) for c,ps in cs if len(ps)>1]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for c,ps in cs:
        if len(ps)>1: continue
        (i,j),=ps
        contains=[b for b in boxes if b[1]<=i<=b[2] and b[3]<=j<=b[4]]
        if contains:
            contains.sort(key=lambda b:b[5]*(b[2]-b[1]+1)*(b[4]-b[3]+1))
            out[i][j]=contains[0][0]; continue
        # nearest by manhattan distance to box cells
        best=None
        for b in boxes:
            d=min(abs(i-y)+abs(j-x) for y in range(b[1],b[2]+1) for x in range(b[3],b[4]+1))
            key=(d,b[5])
            if best is None or key<best[0]: best=(key,b[0])
        out[i][j]=best[1] if best else bg
    return out

def solve(g):

    keep=set()
    for c,ps in cs:
        if len(ps)>=3: keep|=ps

    while True:
        new=[r[:] for r in out]
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w):
                if (i,j) in keep: continue
                nb=[out[y][x] for y in range(max(0,i-1),min(h,i+2)) for x in range(max(0,j-1),min(w,j+2)) if (y,x)!=(i,j)]
                cnt=Counter(nb)
                m,n=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0],cnt.most_common(1)[0][1]
                if n==1 and (i,j) not in keep and out[i][j]!=m: continue
                new[i][j]=m if n>0 else out[i][j]
        if new==out: break
        out=new
    return out

def solve(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps_of(g,bg)
    boxes=[]
    for c,ps in cs:
        ys=[y for y,_ in ps]; xs=[x for _,x in ps]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
        area=(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1)
        if len(ps)/area>=0.8 and area>=200 and r1-r0>=2 and c1-c0>=2:
            boxes.append((c,r0,r1,c0,c1))
    out=[[v for v in row] for row in g]
    for c,r0,r1,c0,c1 in boxes:
        for y in range(r0,r1+1):
            for x in range(c0,c1+1): out[y][x]=c
    return out

def solve(g,fm=0.75,ma=10,rd=2,cd=2):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps_of(g,bg)
    boxes=[]
    for c,ps in cs:
        ys=[y for y,_ in ps]; xs=[x for _,x in ps]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
        area=(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1)
        if len(ps)/area>=fm and area>=ma and r1-r0>=rd and c1-c0>=cd:
            boxes.append((c,r0,r1,c0,c1))
    out=[[v for v in row] for row in g]
    for c,r0,r1,c0,c1 in boxes:
        for i in range(r0,r1+1):
            for j in range(c0,c1+1): out[i][j]=c
    return out

def solve(g,bg=None,minarea=6,maxhole=2):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    if bg is None: bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps_of(g,bg)
    boxes=[]
    for c,ps in cs:
        ys=[y for y,_ in ps]; xs=[x for _,x in ps]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
        area=(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1)
        holes=sum(1 for y in range(r0,r1+1) for x in range(c0,c1+1) if g[y][x]!=c)
        if len(ps)>=maxhole and len(ps)/area>=0.7:
            boxes.append((c,r0,r1,c0,c1,len(ps)/area))
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    bboxes=[]

        bboxes.append((c,r0,r1,c0,c1))
        for i in range(r0,r1+1):
